title: Gaza Civil Defence Concludes 4-Day Recovery of 19 Bodies From Destroyed Gaza City Building
detail: Gaza's Civil Defence concluded a four-day recovery operation on Saturday, August 8, 2026, retrieving the remains of 19 people — most of them women and children — from the rubble of the destroyed "Karam" residential building on al-Sinaa Street in western Gaza City. Recovery operations overseer Mohammed Abu Dan said crews relied on rudimentary tools and exhausting manual labour due to a continued lack of heavy machinery in Gaza. The recovery came days after a mass funeral held Tuesday, August 4, for 112 people from the Abu Sharia and al-Hasayna families, whose remains were recovered from a Sabra neighbourhood residential block destroyed in a November 2023 Israeli strike. Gaza's Health Ministry says more than 8,000 people remain missing under rubble across the Strip, with the cumulative Gaza death toll surpassing 73,300 killed and 174,000 wounded since October 7, 2023.

media.caption: Gaza Civil Defence crews recover 19 bodies from the rubble of the destroyed Karam building in Gaza City
